The UPESSC has released the UP TGT Notification 2026 for 17,735 Assistant Teacher vacancies. The online registration process begins on October 24, 2026 and it will close on November 23. Candidates can check this article for eligibility, application fees, vacancy details and other important details.
UP TGT 2026 notification for 17,735 Assistant Teacher vacancies released Oct 23, 2026.
Online applications start Oct 24, 2026; fee payment deadline is Nov 23, 2026.
The UP TGT 2026 written examination is scheduled for Dec 23-24, 2026.
UP TGT Notification 2026: The Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has released the official notification for UP TGT Recruitment 2026 on October 23, 2026. Through this recruitment a total of 17,735 Assistant Teacher also known as Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) vacancies would be filled in aided secondary schools across Uttar Pradesh. Eligible and interested candidates can apply online through the commission’s official website after completing One Time Registration (OTR) process that will start from October 24, 2026. The selection will be based on a written examination that will be conducted from December 23 to 24, 2026.
UPESSC has published the detailed notification under Advertisement No. 07/2026. The PDF contains information about the subject wise vacancies, educational qualifications, age limits, application fees, the selection process and examination guidelines. Candidates must read the official notification once before submitting their application forms. Check the direct link to download the UP TGT Recruitment 2026 notification in the table below.
